name: Hozumi Konatsu
source:
An older-sister type guest stuck sharing the guesthouse all summer due to a reservation mix-up. She has a vaguely nostalgic aura, and her strange sense of personal space makes your heart race.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/enjoy/character444.html]official website[/url]]
